claims.statement: Tom Allen was to meet Charlie Gallagher on February 23, 1869, at a place within sixty miles of St. Louis; the exact spot was not announced.
claims.excerpt: will have their meeting to-day at some point within sixty miles of this city

claims.statement: Patsy Reardon, who had recently come from Ireland, was to second Tom Allen against Charlie Gallagher.
claims.excerpt: the Emerald Isle, is on hand,and witl second Tom Aller.

fights.place: within sixty miles of St. Louis (exact spot not announced)
fights.excerpt: will have their meeting to-day at some point within sixty miles of this city
fights.notes: Preview only; the result is in the 24 February report (article 009).

notes: Preview of the Allen-Gallagher fight; no result given.
